changelog: Adds a build for Jellyfin 12.0. Fixes the plugin page, which did not show output directories, libraries, or recent exports. Exports now include audio, video, and subtitle stream details and user watch state, and downloads work on Jellyfin 12.0. The plugin page explains every error, and exports no longer leave an unzipped copy on disk.
description: Export a readable inventory manifest of Jellyfin libraries, media files, metadata provider IDs, media streams, and optional user watch state.
name: Library Inventory Exporter
overview: Export Jellyfin library inventory to CSV and JSON.
